hook_en: He hears you, and He comes quickly. 🙏
reflect_en: David didn't hide his need. He asked God to lean in, listen and rescue him quickly. As the weekend begins, take refuge in Him and bring Him what you have been carrying all week.
q_en: What do you need God to hear from you today?
x_en: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge
tiktok: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue 🙏 Psalm 31:1–2 — He is your rock of refuge
yt_title: Be My Rock of Refuge | Psalm 31:1-2 #Shorts
li_open: Asking for help is not weakness. It's wisdom.
li_quote: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.
li_body: David led a nation, yet he prayed honestly about his need and asked God to listen. Leaders who model that kind of honest prayer make it safe for the people they serve to share their own requests, and a church that listens well reflects the God who inclines His ear.
hook_es: Él te escucha y viene a librarte. 🙏
reflect_es: David no escondió su necesidad: le pidió a Dios que inclinara Su oído y lo librara pronto. En este fin de semana, refúgiate en Él y entrégale lo que has cargado toda la semana.
q_es: ¿Qué necesitas que Dios escuche de ti hoy?
x_es: Inclina a mí tu oído, líbrame presto; séme por roca de fortaleza
